description_en: Modifies the information of an IM group
kebab_example: aliyun cams update-chat-group --business-number 8613800000 --cust-space-id cams-000 --group-id EA303000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateChatGroup

parameters.help_en: The business phone number. You can view the business phone number by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2932629.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 商家号码。可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2932629.html接口查看商家号码
parameters.name: business_number

parameters.help_en:
The channel type. Valid values:

WHATSAPP.

Only the WhatsApp channel type is supported
parameters.help_zh:
类型。取值：

WHATSAPP。

暂仅支持WhatsApp通道类型的消息
parameters.name: channel_type

parameters.help_en: The space ID of the ISV sub-customer, which is also the instance ID. This is the channel ID, which can be viewed on the Channel Management (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement) page
parameters.help_zh: ISV子客户的SpaceId/实例ID。即通道ID，在通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)界面查看
parameters.name: cust_space_id

parameters.help_en: The group ID. You can view the group ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2932629.html operation
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The group profile picture.

Image restrictions:
Supported MIME type: image/jpeg
Maximum image size: 5 MB
The image must be square with a minimum dimension of 192 × 192 pixels
parameters.help_zh:
群组头像。

图片限制
仅支持的mime type：image/jpeg
图片大小最大：5MB
图片必须是正方形，最小宽高：192 x 192
parameters.name: profile_picture_file
